verdict.rationale: Skyfire issues scoped pay/kya-pay tokens with committed amount ceilings, expiry windows (10s-24h plus grace period), and merchant/identity-requirement gating rather than raw card numbers, all documented via API and MCP server tooling. Missing for 10: independent third-party/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and explicit merchant-restriction scoping details (evidence shows identity/amount/time limits clearly but merchant-lock-in specifics are thinner).
